target_rule: date >= cutoff; rating >= 4; item in cutoff catalog; never rated before cutoff
candidate_rule: submitted < cutoff; valid nonempty normalized ingredients
eligible_user_rule: at least 5 distinct positive history recipes and at least 1 eligible target
profile_rule: first 5 distinct positive history recipes (final); 'recent' 5 kept as a sensitivity analysis; equal-weight mean of L2-normalized TF-IDF vectors
seen_rule: exclude every recipe rated 1-5 before cutoff, not just H
relevance_rule: binary; future rating >=4; deduplicate user-recipe targets
idf_rule: fit on Allrecipes training recipe documents only; frozen on Food.com
scope: Fixed-date recommendation of recipes already available at cutoff; later new recipes excluded
